AURORA

ambient machine · M-VAVE FM-1 firmware, emulated

Scene
Scale
Root

It plays by itself once it is on. Drag a knob up or down; what it changes shows on the screen.

The panel is the FM-1's own, at its real proportions: grey is what is printed on the device, green is what it does in AURORA. Dimmed buttons do nothing here. On a phone, turn it sideways, or use the phone layout: the same controls, bigger.

ALGORITHM
the scene
SELECT
the scale
PRESETS
the root note; or hold SCL and press a key
KNOB 1–4
the row of four below; FX switches rows
Row 1
DENSITY how often notes come · BRIGHT · SPACE the reverb, 2 s to 30 s · DRIFT detune and how fast the sky moves
Row 2
ECHO · BELLS · WIND · DRONE
Play
the machine plays or waits; the keys always play, snapped to the scale
Freeze
the reverb holds what is in it, for ever
Bells
a fall of bells now. Each bell flares a star; some send a shooting star
Save
keep the scene and settings for next time

Computer keyboard: Z–/ S–' Q–O the keys · ← → scene · ↑ ↓ scale · Space play · Shift freeze · Enter bells

No sound on an iPhone? Turn the ring/silent switch to ring.

AURORA is free software (GPL-3.0), built on GR!MM's platform, DSP and reverb, which stand on Felucca, Dinghy, SLOOP and X0X. The screen font is Terminus (SIL OFL 1.1). Unofficial firmware, not made or endorsed by M-VAVE.
